candidates.name: Valorant
candidates.manifesto: the unique, 3–5 character alphanumeric code that follows a player's Riot ID, making each ID unique across all Riot Games

candidates.name: Fortnite
candidates.manifesto: The Storm doesn't wait—and neither should you

candidates.name: Grand Theft Auto 5
candidates.tagline: All we had to do was follow the damn train, CJ!
candidates.manifesto: We are building a crime syndicate of extraordinary magnitude

candidates.name: Solo Leveling
candidates.manifesto: Solo Leveling, also alternatively translated as Only I Level Up is a South Korean fantasy web novel written by Chugong. It was serialized in Kakao's digital comic and fiction platform

candidates.name: One Piece
candidates.tagline: I'm going to be the King of the Pirates! -Monkey D. Luffy!
candidates.manifesto: One Piece is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Eiichiro Oda. It follows the adventures of Monkey D. Luffy and his crew, the Straw Hat Pirates, as he explores the Grand Line in search of the mythical treasure known as the "One Piece" to become the next King of the Pirates

candidates.name: Death Note
candidates.tagline: The human whose name is written in this note shall die!!!
candidates.manifesto: A high-school student discovers a supernatural notebook that grants its user the ability to kill.

candidates.name: Shangri-La Frontier
candidates.tagline: Listen, you want to know the truth about the world?
candidates.manifesto: Rakurō Hizutome is interested in playing bad games; he tries the new VR game "Shangri-La Frontier."

candidates.name: Chainsaw Man
candidates.tagline: Denji is a young boy who works as a Devil Hunter
candidates.manifesto: Chainsaw Man is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Tatsuki Fujimoto. Its first arc was serialized in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from December 2018 to December 2020; its second arc began serialization in Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website in July 2022.

candidates.name: Hotel Transylvania 4: Transformania
candidates.manifesto: Count Dracula runs a high-end resort for monsters and is overprotective of his daughter, Mavis. When a human named Johnny enters the hotel, Dracula tries to prevent Mavis from falling for him

candidates.name: Zootopia 2
candidates.tagline: I have to set things right
candidates.manifesto: Detectives Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde find themselves on the twisting trail of a mysterious reptile who turns the mammal metropolis of Zootopia upside down. Testing their growing partnership like never before, they go under cover in new parts of town to crack the case.

candidates.name: Ne Zha 2
candidates.tagline: If heaven and earth will not accept me, I will change this heaven and earth!
candidates.manifesto: A rebellious young boy, Ne Zha, is feared by the gods and born to mortal parents with wild, uncontrolled powers. Now that he's faced with an ancient force intent on destroying humanity, he must grow up to become the hero the world needs.

candidates.name: Hollow Knight: SilkSong
candidates.tagline: Ascend to the peak of a haunted kingdom
candidates.manifesto: Hollow Knight: Silksong is a 2025 Metroidvania video game developed and published by Australian independent developer Team Cherry

candidates.name: Battlegrounds Mobile India
candidates.manifesto: Battlegrounds Mobile India, previously known as PUBG Mobile India, is a version of PUBG Mobile, available in India. It is an online multiplayer battle royale game by Krafton. The game was initially released on 2 July 2021 for Android devices, and on 18 August 2021 for iOS devices.
